decision: Diagnostic retained; investigate successful quadratic projection costs without removing the proven-necessary fallback. No new runtime admission.
meaning_of_counts: Retained success means the first recognizer used at least one cached certificate and its requested projection succeeded. It does not mean a root cache hit. Cold decline means no retained certificate was used. Retry success/decline describes the original recognizer after an unsuccessful retained pass.
interpretation: Quadratic projection dominates this recorded workload. Its retained-success calls account for about 23.8 seconds of first-pass timers; unsuccessful original retries add about 17.6 seconds. These observations guide another consumer-cost experiment but do not prove a cache or rewrite will meet the board gate.
fallback_requirement: No fallback recovered a proof on these two boards, but expansion_at_a_term_limit_retries_the_original_proof is a passing deterministic counterexample to removing it. The eight/nine-term frontier and all original limits remain part of every later candidate gate.
timing_limits: Instrumentation changes code generation and adds timer/counter overhead. Durations are partial wall-time measurements around recognition/projection; success timing excludes later reconstruction and memo destruction. Inclusive work elsewhere may overlap. These are not matched speedup measurements, CPU profile percentages, or an extrapolation to every caller.
compilation_failure_preserved: diagnostic-v1 failed before executing its five tests because its counter format string had an unmatched closing brace. diagnostic-v1-correction.json and both source archives/logs preserve that failure and the corrected diagnostic-v2 build.
next_step: Evaluate a narrow path for obtaining and combining already certified quadratic coefficients, reducing vector allocation on successful queries. Keep original recognition as the fallback, preserve proof publication and ownership, and measure first/warm/cloned/opaque controls before any retention. Also update public recognition-budget wording before considering a cache runtime admission.
